SELECT T2.AvgScrMath, T3.County AS County_Name 
FROM (
    SELECT 
        T1.CDSCode, 
        (T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrWrite) / 3 AS total_avg_score, 
        T2.AvgScrMath
    FROM frpm AS T1 
    INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
    WHERE T2.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL 
      AND T2.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL 
      AND T2.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL 
      AND T2.AvgScrMath BETWEEN 400 AND 1600 
      AND T2.AvgScrRead BETWEEN 400 AND 1600 
      AND T2.AvgScrWrite BETWEEN 400 AND 1600
) AS T2
INNER JOIN schools AS T3 ON T2.CDSCode = T3.CDSCode
ORDER BY total_avg_score ASC 
LIMIT 1;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH RaceResults AS (
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        res.time,
        res.position,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceId ORDER BY res.position) AS position_rank
    FROM 
        races r
    JOIN 
        results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE 
        r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND res.statusId IS NOT NULL
),
Champion AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 10) AS REAL) AS champion_time
    FROM RaceResults
    WHERE position_rank = 1
),
LastDriver AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 10) AS REAL) AS last_driver_time
    FROM RaceResults
    WHERE position_rank = (SELECT MAX(position_rank) FROM RaceResults)
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN last_driver_time IS NOT NULL AND champion_time IS NOT NULL THEN 
            (CAST((last_driver_time - champion_time) AS REAL) / last_driver_time) * 100
        ELSE 
            NULL 
    END AS percentage_faster_than_last_driver
FROM 
    Champion, LastDriver;	----- bird -----	formula_1
